spindle.observe.NodeKind.title: NodeKind
spindle.observe.NodeKind.description: What one node of the topology stands for. `ingress`: the run's router, one per listener. `specification`: one loaded specification. `domain`: a domain of a specification. `command`, `view`, `event`: one declared in a domain. `external`: one external cause of a command's outcome. `binding`: one event or periodic binding, the channel an event travels.

spindle.observe.TopologyNode.title: TopologyNode
spindle.observe.TopologyNode.description: One node of the topology, derived from the loaded specifications, never authored.

id.description: Unique in the answer: `ingress`, the specification's system identifier, or the qualified name, prefixed by the kind and, for an external cause, the command and outcome, such as `external:tasks.ledger.Settle/settled`.

name.description: The name as the specification writes it.

specification.description: The system identifier of the specification it belongs to; absent for the ingress.
